name: Dedi
description: A tall, weaker initiate of the Tah crop who dissolves in acid filth in the first obstacle.

timeline.summary: Dedi wades into a filth pool to turn a crank that raises a bridge, but acid filth floods the chamber and dissolves him as the crop flees; one initiate is lost.
timeline.quote: skin and flesh sloughed off his forearm, revealing bone.
